[[File:HuosnoughowFoundation.png|thumb|right|250px|The Huosnoughhow Foundation]]
The '''Huosnoughhow Foundation''' was a powerful financial think tank with close ties to Senate budgeting. It had a skyscraper in the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

[[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used a [[Skytunnel/Legends|skytunnel]] in the building to evade [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
